title: When the clocks disagree
lines: Two clocks disagree, and suddenly the explanation you trusted no longer fits.
The World Does Not Read Equations asks what a law of nature actually tells us.
Its journey moves through physics, philosophy, artificial intelligence, and the possibility of simulated worlds.

title: What a law promises
lines: Predicting what happens is different from knowing why it happens, or what could change it.
A formula can work beautifully without telling us everything about the world.
The book asks what evidence could help us choose between its more unusual possibilities.

emotionalPlan.arc: Curiosity deepens through a concrete tension
emotionalPlan.purpose: Predicting an event, explaining it, and knowing what would change it are different achievements. A successful formula can reveal a real constraint without settling the universe’s final story. The book keeps unusual possibilities tied to the evidence that could distinguish them.
